purpose: Exact-item, rights-aware discovery providers for Pattern Lab source-first city-history production.
default_rule: Discovery is not acceptance. A candidate becomes production media only after exact item metadata, creator, rights basis, local download hash, claim relevance, and editorial role pass the existing evidence-intake gates.

providers.name: Openverse
providers.promotion_rule: Verify the original landing page before download; Openverse does not guarantee the source license metadata.

providers.name: Library of Congress
providers.role: historical photographs, maps, documents, and film discovery
providers.access: anonymous JSON API with rate limits
eligible_rights: item-level commercial and modification compatible statement
providers.promotion_rule: Verify the exact Rights & Access statement and downloaded file; presence in the catalog is not a blanket rights clearance.

providers.name: Wikimedia Commons
providers.access: anonymous MediaWiki API with rate limits
providers.promotion_rule: Preserve exact file-page attribution and share-alike obligations; reject NC, ND, and unclear licenses.

providers.name: Flickr Commons
providers.access: browser or API discovery; exact institution item verification required
eligible_rights: no known copyright restrictions or independently compatible item license
providers.promotion_rule: The Commons program is not itself a license. Verify the contributing institution, exact item statement, creator, and download before evidence intake.

providers.name: Internet Archive / Prelinger
providers.role: archival motion and historical context discovery
providers.access: anonymous metadata API with rate limits
providers.promotion_rule: Fetch item metadata and select a locally downloadable file only after the item-level license is compatible; Internet Archive availability alone is never sufficient.

providers.name: U.S. National Archives Catalog
eligible_rights: item-level public domain or compatible rights statement
providers.promotion_rule: Federal-agency origin is a useful signal, not a blanket rights decision; Special Media and donated records require item-level review.

providers.name: Smithsonian Open Access
providers.role: CC0 historical images, documents, and objects
providers.promotion_rule: Require an actual CC0 media asset; CC0 metadata without media is not a reusable image.

providers.name: Digital Public Library of America
eligible_rights: Unlimited Re-Use or independently verified compatible statement
providers.promotion_rule: DPLA is a metadata broker. Verify the contributing institution's exact item and rights page before download.

providers.name: USGS and federal geospatial data
providers.role: source-grounded present-day map and terrain context
eligible_rights: U.S. government public-domain data unless the exact item says otherwise
providers.promotion_rule: Use as map/context evidence only; preserve dataset/item URL, date, and transformation steps.

hard_blocks: candidate promoted from search results without original landing-page verification
CC BY-NC or CC BY-ND material used in a monetized Pattern Lab package
Internet Archive item accepted solely because it is downloadable
Openverse license metadata treated as final without original-source confirmation
provider search URL stored as an asset source URL
modern context footage presented as proof of a historical claim
